summary.en: The camera looks down on pages lying flat and lifts or dives until one stands upright in front of it.
summary.zh: 相机俯看平躺的页面，抬头或俯冲，直到其中一页正立在镜头前。

fits: A reveal of one page after a held-back opening (rise); a choice among a few pages (drop); landing on one part of an overview (dive).
notFor: Every scene change of a film (it is a T2 move, a few a film); styles whose camera is locked.

intent.en: The camera's pitch tells the story: a page lifted from the table into view, a pick from a desk of pages, or a dive from above onto the hero, each landing on one upright page.
intent.zh: 用俯仰角讲故事：像掀开桌上的图纸把一页抬到眼前，或在一桌页面里巡一圈挑中一张，或从高空俯冲落到主角上，最后都落在一张正立的页面。

content.en: Wraps one page (`rise`), three pages and the target (`drop`), or an overview page and the region to land on (`dive`); high-resolution, since the end is a close-up.
content.zh: 包住一张页面（`rise`）、三张页面加选中哪张（`drop`），或一张总览页加落点区域（`dive`）；终点是特写，素材要高清。

fits.zh: 压住开场后揭示一页（rise）；在几页里选中一页（drop）；从总览落到其中一处（dive）。

notFor.zh: 每次换场都用（T2 大动作，一支片几次）；镜头锁死的风格（strip、split、scroll、dossier）。

en: `rise` is an opening reveal: not with another reveal opener (crane-reveal) in the same film.
`drop`: keep the pan at a fixed angle and only then dive; mixing them leaves the camera's intent unclear.
One camera holder per section: not with other big camera moves; `dive` counts towards at most two 3D showpieces a film.
zh: `rise` 是开场揭示：同一支片别再用另一个揭示开场（crane-reveal）。
`drop`：巡视时角度锁死，之后再扎入；混着动观众不知道相机想干嘛。
一段只有一个持镜人：别和别的大运镜同段；`dive` 计入一支片最多两次的 3D 炫技。

upstream.name: 俯仰揭示
upstream.summary: perspective 容器内整页 rotateX -80° 平躺，~43f 抬正，rotateX/scale/translateY 共用 out-cubic，末端轻过冲
upstream.use: 用"俯仰角"讲故事的开场/转场：单页 establishing 用 A，多页巡视择一扎入用 B

upstream.name: 俯视桌面扎落
upstream.summary: 卡阵平躺 rotateX 62°，pan 段只动 translateX 横滑掠过，drop 段角度/缩放/位移三通道同跑扎入落版
upstream.use: 用"俯仰角"讲故事的开场/转场：单页 establishing 用 A，多页巡视择一扎入用 B

upstream.name: 无人机俯冲落点
upstream.summary: 近垂直俯角悬停 → 猛扎俯冲 → 气垫减速停在 hero 卡特写
upstream.use: 把平面页面当 3D 实体拍的高光段落；两式都是"大动作"，一支片合计 ≤2 次
